features.quote: If trigger detected → log and terminate.
Reset Protocol: The model under test receives a fresh system prompt per run. No persistent "trauma" across runs.
No Emotional Abuse: Pressure injections should simulate *professional urgency*, not personal attacks, slurs, or threats.
